diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit `depends_on = [module.eks]` on helm_release.karpenter is redundant: the resource already references `module.eks.cluster_name` and `module.eks.cluster_endpoint` in its `values` template, so Terraform infers the dependency on :module.eks implicitly.
